entities.summary: George Stephen West, ARCS, FLS, was a British botanist, a specialist in phycology and protistology, a botanical illustrator and a writer. With his father, botanist William West, he collaborated on numerous scientific books. West's brother was the botanist William West Jr, who assisted their father with fieldwork.
